correctness.rationale: For a,b,c>0 and every h>=0, the numerator of each of the six distinct offdiagonal entries is an exact integer polynomial proved by the adjugate construction in verify.py. D=det(M)/48>0 because L is positive semidefinite and x^2+6x+12>0 for x>=0. If C_a,C_b,C_c>=0, hub-leaf coefficient inequalities and a leaf-leaf implication give strict positivity for h>0; all diagonals are positive since F(x)>0 on x>=0. If C_a<0, the leading term bc C_a h^4 makes T_01 negative for every sufficiently large h, and permutations cover all failures. Exact witness (4,1,1,h=8) gives -6240/106309. No finite tests are used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The first branching tree is a natural minimal test case for high-order positivity under heterogeneous edge diffusion. An exact three-parameter all-timestep classification distinguishes structural stability and conservation from positivity, includes equality cases, supplies counterexamples, and connects a known resistance design cone with a nontrivial finite-step rational numerical property. The result is a complete structural boundary, not a parameter substitution, numerical experiment, or arbitrary isolated value.
